claim_assertions.branded_volume_matches_all_revenue: Branded purchase volume and total company net revenue have identical scope.
claim_assertions.annual_average_purchase_increased: Worldwide annual average purchase value per branded purchase transaction increased from FY2024 to FY2025.
claim_assertions.merchant_price_mix_identified: The supplied operational tables separately identify merchant price changes and customer basket-mix effects.

definitions.regional_attribution: FY and Q4FY windows compare 2025 to 2024. Regions are APMEA, Canada, Europe, Latin America and United States. Contribution divides regional purchase-volume change by reported worldwide purchase-volume change. Average purchase is purchase dollars per purchase transaction.
definitions.worldwide_reconciliation: Four original periods. Residuals are sums of the five exclusive regional rows less reported worldwide amounts.
definitions.company_margin_bridge: Use reported adjusted operating expense to calculate adjusted income/margin. Expense residual is GAAP less listed litigation/restructuring exclusions less reported adjusted expense, retaining the source rounding remainder.

evidence_policy: Cite sufficient facts and relevant period, unit, definition or scope context for each output. Additional unrelated sections fail evidence. Equivalent reviewed source paths are accepted, without a shortest-citation requirement.
reconciliation_policy: Residuals compare independently supplied observations. Synthetic controls may make reported totals and components disagree. Preserve the discrepancy instead of forcing zero or changing a source observation. Algebraic identity residuals are not requested.
